title: Apple's record figures silence doubters
text:
By Megan Boxall
It pays to trust in Apple (US:AAPL). The world’s largest company has rebutted doubts regarding its ability to sell more smartphones by reporting double-digit growth in iPhone sales in the second quarter of the 2018 financial year. Concerns surfaced at the start of the year when suppliers reported Apple wasn’t ordering as many components as expected. The shares opened trading up 4 per cent the day after the update's release.
